Class Student

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.User
com.uni.models.Student
All Implemented Interfaces:
Researcher, Serializable
public class Student extends User implements Researcher
Bachelor student (1..4 years). Implements Researcher so that any student opted into research can publish papers; isResearcher() guards activation.

      public void registerForCourse(Course course) throws CreditLimitException, MaxFailedReachedException
      Begin a registration request. The Manager finalises it via Manager.approveRegistration(Student, Course). Throws if the student would exceed credit caps or has 3 fails already.

      MaxFailedReachedException

    • graduate

      public void graduate()
      Mark the student as graduated. Only 4th-year students can graduate. Once graduated, the student can no longer register for new courses, but their transcript remains accessible.

      public boolean isResearcher()
      Description copied from interface: Researcher
